projects.name: invoice-export
projects.purpose: Nightly invoice extract written to the finance share, with row count parity and failure alerting.
projects.done_means: The dated file exists, the row count matches the source, and a failure alerts the owning channel naming the failing step.
pain_points: Reruns used to duplicate a day's file.
Schema drift in the source shows up as a silent count mismatch.

projects.name: platform-scripts
projects.purpose: Shared operational scripts the team runs by hand on Windows.
projects.done_means: The script runs clean on a fresh checkout under Windows PowerShell 5.1 and its usage is in the README.
pain_points: Scripts written on a newer shell fail on 5.1 in ways nobody catches until someone else runs them.
